story: HT-074: Leave-Page Protection for Unsaved Topology Changes

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Given unsaved topology changes, when navigating away via sidebar or breadcrumb, prompt shown with Save Version / Discard / Cancel
observations: Sidebar click (Dashboard) with _htHasUnsavedChanges=true → modal displayed with all 3 buttons
Breadcrumb click (Workspaces) with unsaved changes → modal displayed
Header logo <a href> link click with unsaved changes → modal displayed via fallback click handler
Guard fires from edit mode (STOP EDITING visible, Draft badge shown) → modal confirmed in screenshot

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Given Save Version chosen, save succeeds, new history version created, navigation proceeds
observations: Clicked Save Version in leave modal → POST /api/topologies/{id}/save-version fired
Navigation to Dashboard completed (http://localhost:8080/)
GET /api/topologies/{id}/history confirmed: count=3 (new entry), latest action='save_version', created_at='2026-04-15T20:28:04'

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Given Discard chosen, draft discarded, navigation proceeds
observations: Clicked Discard in leave modal → DELETE /api/topologies/{id}/personal-draft returned 200
Navigation to Dashboard completed (http://localhost:8080/)
Network log confirmed: reqid=206 DELETE ...personal-draft [200]

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Given Cancel chosen, user remains on topology page, draft intact
observations: Clicked Cancel → modal.style.display = 'none'
URL unchanged: still on /topology?topology_id=...
_htHasUnsavedChanges remained true after Cancel

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Given no unsaved changes, leaving page shows no prompt
observations: _htHasUnsavedChanges=false on fresh page load
Sidebar click (Dashboard) with clean state → no modal, navigated directly to /
Modal element did not exist in DOM when navigating from clean state

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Browser/tab close with unsaved changes triggers browser-native leave warning
observations: Dispatched synthetic beforeunload event with _htHasUnsavedChanges=true
event.returnValue set to 'You have unsaved topology changes.' confirming handler fires
With _htHasUnsavedChanges=false: event.returnValue NOT set (handler correctly bypasses)
Native browser dialog cannot be further automated; behavior matches spec intent

implementation_notes: data-ht-guard-nav and data-ht-nav-target HTML attributes are NOT rendered to the physical DOM (NiceGUI .props() on ui.row/ui.label does not produce data-* HTML attributes). Guard interception works via NiceGUI's internal Vue/WebSocket component event mechanism instead.
All guard trigger paths verified: sidebar nav items, breadcrumb links, header logo <a> link fallback
Leave guard correctly scoped to Admin+Contributor roles (inject_topology_leave_guard skips Reader via _EDIT_ROLES check)
Draft badge in header correctly reflects _htHasUnsavedChanges=true state
No bugs found. All 6 acceptance criteria pass.
